name: telaris-pcs-admin
description: Telaris PCS system administration MCP tools. Requires system-administrator access.

host.title: PCS hostname
host.description: Hostname of your Telaris PCS instance, without https:// — for example pcs.telaris.no

token.title: MCP auth key
token.description: Your personal auth key from /mcp on your PCS instance. Treat it like a password.
